heroSubhead: Help sustain the Harvard Alumni in Tech community and the connections, opportunities, and support that move us forward.

accomplishments.label: WhatsApp community members
accomplishments.body: Built and grew a WhatsApp community where alumni ask, answer, and introduce each other every day.

accomplishments.label: LinkedIn followers
accomplishments.body: Grew our LinkedIn following into the widest reach this community has ever had.

accomplishments.label: Events hosted and co-hosted
accomplishments.body: Hosted and co-hosted high-impact events, from founder dinners to panels with alumni operators.

accomplishments.label: New chapters launched
accomplishments.body: Expanded our global reach with new chapters in London and San Francisco.

pillars.title: Create Meaningful Connections
pillars.body: Support events, roundtables, and gatherings that help alumni build valuable relationships and discover new opportunities.

pillars.title: Expand Access to Knowledge
pillars.body: Power practical content, mentorship, and conversations that help founders, innovators, and tech professionals grow.

pillars.title: Strengthen the Network
pillars.body: Build the infrastructure, volunteer resources, and city chapters needed to serve more alumni and sustain the community.

donorsIntro: Every name here chose to put something behind this community. Founding donors gave before there was anything to point to.
donorsEmptyMessage: The Momentum Fund is just beginning, and this wall is waiting for its first names. Give today and yours will be among them.

donorTiers.description: The gifts that let us plan a year ahead instead of an event at a time.

donorTiers.name: Sustaining Donors
donorTiers.description: Monthly support that keeps the chapters, dinners, and mentorship running.

donorTiers.name: Supporting Donors
donorTiers.description: Every gift at every size, from alumni who wanted to be part of it.

ctaBody: Join the alumni choosing to move from informal support to intentional investment, every month.
